name: Doki Doki Youth Soutsu
source:
In this story, you take up the life of a young man just beginning his University life, but finds himself surrounded by a few strange girls. Where will your choices take you in this story of love, lust, and personal acceptance?

Play the game and find out!
translation:
在这个故事中，你扮演一个刚刚开始大学生活的年轻人的生活，却发现自己被几个奇怪的女孩包围。在这个关于爱、欲望和个人接受的故事中，你的选择将带你走向何方？

玩游戏就知道了！
